brief: The canvas displays an intricate, interlocking tessellation of hexagons. These geometric shapes are in constant, subtle motion, rotating and shifting against each other to create mesmerizing patterns. The visual core is a rich, high-contrast palette, where the rotation of any individual hexagon directly influences and dictates the color shifts observed in its neighboring cells. The pattern flows dynamically, creating a complex, living visual field of interlocking, shifting color and movement.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing tessellation of interlocking hexagons that shift and rotate in harmony. Each hexagon subtly influences its neighbors through a dynamic color system where rotation directly affects hue values. The pattern flows organically without any external input, with each shape continuously evolving based on both its own motion and the collective behavior of surrounding cells. The high-contrast palette ensures visual impact while the constant motion generates an almost living field of geometric rhythm.
